stories.title: Record 230 people cross Channel to UK as smugglers turn to 'mega-dinghies'
stories.summary: A dinghy carrying a record 230 people arrived in the UK, the clearest sign yet that Channel smugglers are shifting to larger vessels to evade enforcement. The Home Office said it is intensifying enforcement with French partners despite the incident.

stories.title: More areas in England declared in drought after record dry July
stories.summary: The National Drought Group confirmed 71.3% of England is now in drought, affecting 45 million people, after the driest July in 190 years. Water Minister Emma Hardy urged water companies to cut leaks and households to conserve water.

stories.title: Minister visits Port of Tyne to support plastic pellet clean-up
stories.summary: Marine Minister Stephen Morgan visited the Port of Tyne to review the response to a spill of roughly 17 tonnes of plastic pellets (nurdles) after a vessel collision, thanking volunteers and outlining further Environment Agency support.

stories.title: Thames Water's £1m payout to finance chief is 'unacceptable', says government department
stories.summary: Defra criticised Thames Water for paying its finance chief a £1m signing fee while the utility teeters near collapse, intensifying calls for the government to take the company into special administration.

stories.title: No evidence of data breach after Chinese-made component found in Navy drones, MoD says
stories.summary: The MoD said a routine cyber assessment of new Royal Navy K3 Scout sea drones found a Chinese-made camera component sending heartbeat signals to a Chinese IP address, but found no evidence of a data or systems breach.

stories.title: New trust and new open source platform for Bristol NHS
stories.summary: The newly formed Bristol NHS Foundation Trust became the first NHS organisation to launch a website on LocalNHS Drupal, a new open-source platform for NHS bodies built with AI-powered search and improved accessibility.
